verdict.rationale: The only exit path in the evidence is indirect: the Admin GraphQL API and GraphiQL can run queries 'to extract information' (shopify-docs-x3, shopify-docs-31), and webhooks keep external systems in sync with Shopify data (shopify-docs-43). A community report says users without certain account types had to 'put up with CSV parsing with limited amount of information' (shopify-comm-12), which suggests CSV export exists but is incomplete. Missing for 10: a documented complete data-export feature, confirmation that all data types (orders, customers, themes, apps) can be exported, an explicit open-format guarantee, documented migration/offboarding support, and independent hands-on confirmation of a full export.
